# mooncake fleet

Manage and operate a personal fleet of mooncake peers (experimental)

## Description

Drive plans across machines you own: discover peers, sync plan trees, apply with multiplexed logs. Peers are configured in ~/.config/mooncake/peers.toml.

## Subcommands

- [apply](fleet_apply.md) — Apply a plan to one or more fleet peers
- [bootstrap](fleet_bootstrap.md) — Install mooncake on a remote box via SSH and register it as a peer
- [discover](fleet_discover.md) — List candidate peers from peers.toml and ~/.ssh/config
- [doctor](fleet_doctor.md) — Run an opinionated probe ladder against one peer
- [exec](fleet_exec.md) — Run an ad-hoc shell command on one or more fleet peers
- [facts](fleet_facts.md) — Read facts from a peer, or compare a key across the fleet
- [init](fleet_init.md) — Interactive setup — discover peers and add them to peers.toml
- [logs](fleet_logs.md) — Attach to a peer's run logs (latest in-flight or terminal)
- [mac-refresh](fleet_mac-refresh.md) — Read each peer's MAC over agentd and store it in peers.toml
- [observe](fleet_observe.md) — Read typed state across peers (spec-64): port, process, http, service, cpu, memory, disk, gpu
- [pair](fleet_pair.md) — Register an already-running agentd as a fleet peer
- [ps](fleet_ps.md) — List in-flight (or recent) runs across fleet peers
- [shutdown](fleet_shutdown.md) — Power off one or more fleet peers via agentd
- [status](fleet_status.md) — Show one-line-per-peer health for the configured fleet
- [up](fleet_up.md) — Wake one or more peers via Wake-on-LAN
- [upgrade](fleet_upgrade.md) — Push a new agentd binary to fleet peers and trigger re-exec
- [watch](fleet_watch.md) — Stream live events from every peer; `tail -f` for the fleet
